motions.description: Approve all items on the consent agenda including minutes, bills and vouchers, license applications, and various ordinances.
Approve two raffle applications submitted by John Machonga, Treasurer American Veteran Community Trust to hold raffles during the Taste of Elmwood Park and at Donny G's Ristorante.
Approve a raffle application submitted by Sandra Sugg, Secretary Grand Chamber by O'Hare to hold a 'Split the Pot' raffle at the Circle Car Show June 13, 2025.
Issue a Proclamation for 'Safe Boating Week' in the Village of Elmwood Park, May 17-23, 2025.
Issue a Proclamation for 'Motorcycle Awareness Month' in the Village of Elmwood Park for the month of May 2025.
Approve a recommendation from the Traffic & Safety Commission to install two 'Stop' signs with flashing lights East & West bound on Westwood Drive at 78th Court with street striping if needed.

Approve a recommendation from the Traffic & Safety Commission to increase the '2-Hour' Diagonal Parking spots on 78th Court at Belmont from two spots to four spots and change time on signage to read 'Between 12pm-10pm'.
